confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors use NYC price data around July 2026. Cocktail is based on a local typical range; wine is estimated modestly above draft beer, since detailed Soho wine-list data skews premium. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial seasonal and neighborhood variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates are NYC-specific, while accommodation reflects general knowledge of New York City's high lodging costs in July.
